build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && cargo build --release --locked -p romforge-cli

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' theme: http://theme.localhost; img-src 'self' data: art: http://art.localhost theme: http://theme.localhost; font-src 'self' theme: http://theme.localhost; media-src blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost art: http://art.localhost music: http://music.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Identify, tidy and play your ROM collection
bundle.longDescription: romforge identifies ROMs and disc images against No-Intro, Redump and TOSEC DATs, keeps them in one RomForge folder with their art and metadata, and starts them in RetroArch or a standalone emulator.
